was promised a telephone call from one of the doctors at Ixworth Surgery following an NHS 111 scare about a blood test that showed an abnormality with my troponin levels. These indicate the possibility of a heart attack. Two weeks later I telephoned the surgery and said I was still waiting for the call. I was told that there was no record of any telephone call booked for a doctor to call me and the receptionist said that a forthcoming appointment with the diabetic nurse would explain all the symptoms of the blood test. I tried to explain to her that the treponin levels were nothing to do with blood sugar levels. She told me that she didn’t know what treponin is. I have total admiration for W.S. Hospital but I have lost all trust with the Ixworth surgery, sadly.
